summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $6,619,798 of its Class A ordinary shares via an ATM Agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co. The company may sell shares from time to time directly on Nasdaq or through the agent at prevailing market prices, subject to a one-third public float limitation under Form F-3. Wainwright earns a 3.0% commission and is deemed an underwriter. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. No fixed price, premium, or deal terms are provided; only the maximum aggregate offering amount and commission structure are stated.
